description:
THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION throws you into a deadly prehistoric jungle where survival means outsmarting nature’s fiercest predators. Explore abandoned research sites, scavenge vital supplies, and evade relentless dinosaurs using stealth, strategy, and the environment.
Use tools and weapons to create distractions or defend yourself briefly. A mysterious voice on the radio offers cryptic guidance as you uncover the island’s dark secrets.

Key Features
	•	Immersive Survival Horror: Confront deadly prehistoric creatures in a tense, jungle setting.
	•	Exploration & Discovery: Uncover secrets hidden in abandoned labs and wild terrain.
	•	Tactical Survival: Gather supplies, craft tools, and use stealth to evade predators.
	•	Smart Enemies: Study dinosaur behavior to adapt and survive evolving threats.
	•	Mystery Unfolds: Follow cryptic radio messages to unravel the island’s dark secrets.
	•	High-Stakes Encounters: Every decision counts against relentless, hunting predators.
	•	Atmospheric Tension: A moody, immersive world where danger lurks in every shadow.

Every encounter is a test of wit and courage. In a world where every shadow may hide a killer, your mind is your greatest weapon.
name: THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION
intro: The jungle hides more than predators.
